name: kiro-spec-library
description: Index, browse, and curate Kiro Specs across repositories with relationship mapping and AI-assisted metadata.
author: Johns Hopkins University Sheridan Libraries
highlights: Relationship graph canvas showing spec dependencies, supersession chains, and suggested connections
Chronological archive ledger with immutable SHA-256-verified snapshots
AI-powered relationship suggestions via TF-IDF content similarity
MCP server for searching specs and proposing metadata changes from any AI assistant
Full-text search across spec titles, content, owners, and themes

setup.onInstall: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && bun install && bun build shared/src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile=shared/dist/index.mjs && bun build backend/src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile=backend/dist/index.mjs && cd ui && bun run build
